cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault; first funding may use wallet-signed CreateAccount or a native Payment to avoid public-account precreation griefing. Connected-wallet support for both remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Official-doc research lists SDF, Tatum, Blockdaemon, Ankr, and QuickNode Horizon as candidates; docs now indicate Blockdaemon mainnet history retention is full history. No endpoints are provisioned or probed. The Stellar root network passphrase, actual operator independence, and quotas remain unverified; no 2-of-3 provider set is selected. Mara Junior completed two read-only Sonnet/Haiku reviews; independent review confirmed the uncredited-deposit and payout-retry evidence gaps are latent because no reachable XLM deposit or payout exists. The plan now records owner-bound recovery and intent-bound fresh replacement evidence. The key setter is guarded, correcting an earlier review concern. Open design, implementation, and release work remains. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved. Official Stellar AccountMerge result-code and account-reserve research now informs owner-bound recovery; merge has protocol blockers and is not guaranteed. The plan distinguishes spendable-residue Payment, terminal merge, and unsolicited-transfer accounting. No API or testnet proof exists. A read-only re-read on 2026-11-03 09:19 UTC returned the same live XRP values (Active; 128%/117%/~132.27%/7.5%; 0.2% fee; 1.5% base APR; $30,000 ceiling; Linear curve; min debt 0.1 icUSD), so the parity target is unchanged. It must be re-read again before any XLM activation.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commit 3ff9f64e changes `fetch_latest_reserve_observations` to apply full latest-ledger quorum and return agreed `LatestLedgerReserve` data (sequence, `closed_at`, and conservative reserve) instead of a value-only amount. No callers exist yet. Commits bdb7d742 and 54c175cf add optional operation identity preservation and bounded fixed-slot provider fetches. Scoped rustfmt/diff checks passed; no Cargo tests or live outcalls have run. This source path does not establish provider independence or live freshness; there is no credit/admission lifecycle. A TLS-verified read of the official public Stellar testnet Horizon host observed the expected testnet passphrase and live ledger/reserve fields, plus HTTP 404 application/problem+json for an unknown transaction. The one-host observation is documented in native-xlm-testnet-horizon-read-2026-10-29.md; no mainnet/provider-quorum proof exists.

cards.scope: Add stable state and an XLM launch guard
cards.evidenceText: Commit d45c8332 adds `State::reserve_xlm_pending_deposit`: a dormant synchronous pending row plus permanent attribution insertion for caller-supplied freshly reserved vault ID and derived classic address, guarded by key/network match, collisions, expiry, and active capacity. Its focused reservation tests passed locally at daf1c440 and the insertion is exercised end to end by the address-open PocketIC smoke. This does not provide public open/confirm APIs, key derivation, outcalls, or credit. Claim/key/receipt/status state remains dormant; generated Candid and frontend declarations were synced on 2026-11-04. Config remains Frozen; XLM is not registered, deployed, or admitted.

cards.scope: Demo: open an XLM pending deposit and show its custody address
cards.evidenceText: Locally completed 2026-11-04. A developer-gated, test-build-only open_xlm_vault endpoint allocates a vault ID, derives a classic Stellar address with the threshold key, and records a pending row plus owner attribution; it credits no collateral and mints no icUSD. At daf1c440 one bounded local batch passed: 156/156 focused Stellar/XLM library tests (after test-only fixture and compile fixes; no product logic changed), the Candid compatibility check, a test-feature Wasm exporting open_xlm_vault (13,744,462 bytes, sha256 2c5a2fc8...2c84), the address-open PocketIC smoke on pocket-ic-server 7.0.0 including the real test_key_1 threshold derive, outsider rejection, testnet binding, no vault and no icUSD, and a production Wasm without the endpoint (13,686,509 bytes, sha256 7c96d153...d6d2). Scope: local evidence only. Not installed on any canister, no hosted CI, no registration; the address is not usable collateral. Deferred items remain in the demo deferral record.

cards.scope: Read back the caller's own pending XLM deposit addresses
cards.evidenceText: Locally completed 2026-11-04 at 81fd7c3d/48ea2690, following XRP's get_my_xrp_pending_deposits pattern. A test-build-only get_my_xlm_pending_deposits query returns only the caller's rows written by open_xlm_vault, as a slim view (vault ID, address, network passphrase, opened/expiry times, status) without owner or derivation nonce. Checks: new caller-scoping unit test 1/1; Candid compatibility 1/1 with the production interface unchanged; test-feature Wasm exports the query and open_xlm_vault (13,713,871 bytes, sha256 d3272d2e...d7eb); the address-open PocketIC smoke passed 1/1 and now reads the opened row back for the developer (matching vault ID, address, network, expiry, Open status) and empty for an outsider and anonymous; production Wasm contains neither method (13,686,592 bytes, sha256 08da0888...3e5c). Frontend declarations were regenerated canonically with scripts/regenerate-declarations.sh, adding only the three XLM key/transform methods already in the production interface. Local evidence only; nothing installed or deployed.

cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Commit d45c8332 adds a dormant synchronous pending-deposit row and permanent custody attribution insertion with key/network, collision, expiry, and active-capacity guards. It accepts a caller-supplied freshly reserved vault ID and derived classic address; its focused tests and the deposit-evidence helper tests passed locally at daf1c440. No public open/confirm API, key derivation, Horizon outcall, or deposit credit is implemented. WP3 remains blocked; provider independence, live reserve/oracle freshness, atomic credit, and testnet/frontend integration remain open. No admission or deployment is proved. The plan now requires an explicit owner-bound recovery outcome for verified but uncredited funds before deposit confirmation becomes reachable; the current pure helper has no such lifecycle. The recovery design now requires owner-selected existing classic destination, durable exact intent, ambiguous-submit reconciliation, and a conditional terminal merge only after obligations clear. Official AccountMerge blockers are documented; implementation and testnet proof remain absent. A developer-only open-address source slice is now in the branch for an isolated test-build demo, with no credit or borrow. It is uncompiled, its test-build Candid is unverified, and it does not make the full deposit path reachable or admissible. On 2026-11-04 commit 85a7249e added the dormant synchronous credit step a confirm endpoint will call after evidence is verified, following confirm_xrp_deposit: it checks the pending row (active, unexpired, caller-owned, matching network and destination), the attribution, duplicate receipt identity across vaults, an already-funded vault, and credit bounds (non-zero, at least 1 XLM, no more than gross) before any change, then records an owned receipt and removes the pending row. cargo test --lib xlm_ passed 20/20 (16 existing plus 4 new, with no-mutation checks on every rejection). It adds no endpoint, outcall, Vault, mint or config change; XLM stays Frozen. Remaining: confirm endpoint with provider quorum and the funding-credit decision, and vault materialization from the receipt.

cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: Commit ac8ba7ea hardens dormant `record_xlm_claim`: it rejects zero or excessive reserved fees, non-classic destinations, and a network ID inconsistent with the selected key before mutating state. Focused test source was added, but compilation/tests remain unrun because the shared heavy slot is not allocated to XLM. The helper remains unwired and does not sign, submit, or settle a claim. WP4 stays blocked; provider independence, evidence freshness, reserve/oracle checks, testnet, frontend, and release remain open. Frozen config prevents XLM admission. The plan now specifies fresh, ordered, intent-bound provider evidence before a replacement payout; the dormant pure retry helper still relies on its future caller for that binding. Mara Junior committed an isolated, untested two-commit source candidate for a bound pure replacement reducer. Independent review held integration: the 404 response and account/ledger scalars still rely on a future trusted provider adapter to prove request hash, provider, freshness, and persisted-intent provenance. No reachable payout retry exists; the main XLM branch does not contain this candidate. Junior commit 421c3e61 adds an isolated typed Horizon status/checkpoint/account read seam and private-field evidence construction. Independent review found no concrete new internal bypass, but caller-built intent and cross-read provider monotonicity remain unproven. No build/tests ran, no main-branch cherry-pick, and payout wiring remains held.

cards.scope: Integrate Candid, user flows, and operator monitoring
cards.evidenceText: Earlier Candid regeneration and compatibility checks passed. The key setter/getter are now in the checked-in interface and the canonical frontend declarations (2026-11-04). Multi-operation receipt/status and frontend guard changes have not been compiled. Full XLM frontend integration and supported deposit/withdrawal/claim flows remain open. The new open_xlm_vault source API is compiled only in test builds; the production Wasm verifiably omits it and the Candid compatibility check passed. Explorer metadata now identifies native XLM and uses seven decimal places; a focused formatting regression is added in source. The test has not run.

cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: Commit d45c8332 adds a guarded dormant pending-deposit recorder, with focused test source but no Cargo test/build. It has no caller/API, derivation path, outcall, or credit mutation. Earlier status and claim helpers remain unverified. Provider independence, live freshness, credit, and settlement remain unproved. WP3/WP4/release remain blocked; no live proof, admission, or deployment. A separate junior-branch retry-evidence candidate is under source review and has not been compiled or tested; it is not main-branch validation. The junior typed-read seam is source-only, uncompiled, untested, and independently reviewed; it does not raise the main branch validation ceiling. A read-only official public Horizon testnet probe checked root, latest-ledger, and unknown-transaction 404 response shapes on one host. It did not create an account, submit a transaction, exercise a canister, or validate the XLM lifecycle. The test-build-only open-address source slice has not compiled or passed its focused test, interface check, or real threshold-derive smoke, so no demo success is claimed. The new XLM address-only PocketIC smoke is source-only and has not compiled or run; it does not raise the demo evidence ceiling. On 2026-11-04, under Merritt's allocation, one bounded local batch ran at daf1c440 (about 13 minutes of build time): focused Stellar/XLM library tests 156 passed, 0 failed after test-only fixes (2 compile errors, 5 stale fixtures, a test-only transform-context seam; no product logic changed); Candid compatibility check passed after syncing three already-implemented XLM methods into the checked-in interface; test-feature Wasm built (13,744,462 bytes, sha256 2c5a2fc8...2c84) and exports open_xlm_vault; the address-open PocketIC smoke passed 1/1 on pocket-ic-server 7.0.0 including the real test_key_1 threshold derive, outsider rejection, testnet binding, no vault and no icUSD; production Wasm built (13,686,509 bytes, sha256 7c96d153...d6d2) and contains no open_xlm_vault. Local evidence only: no hosted CI, no deployment, no registration. Frontend declarations do not yet include the three synced methods; the explorer formatter test and a repo-wide format pass were not run.

cards.scope: Prepare deployment, configuration, and activation evidence
cards.evidenceText: Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; independent bounded reviews confirmed latent design gaps, and the plan records the recovery conditions. The Stellar key setter guard was verified; generated Candid remains stale. Broader release work remains open: current reserve freshness/oracle validation, deposit and claim lifecycles, testnet/frontend integration, exact-head validation, artifact review, and rollback/monitoring. Release is blocked. The live XRP post-sign status race remains a separate XRP reuse caution, not a required XLM gate. No live provider/oracle proof, deployment, or activation is proved.
